A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same BalanceKV research. Their complete text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices are readable and support comparison across relocations and renumbering.

before.justification: v2 reports original attention-approximation, LongBench-E, Needle-In-A-Haystack, ablation, and runtime results.

after.justification: v3 retains those original results and adds embedding-norm measurements, multimodal captioning, additional compression settings, and a ClusterGen comparison.

M1.justification: Algorithms 1–4 remain unchanged. Appendix B.5 adds a partial-cache adaptation: to retain a fraction 1−alpha, halve a selected fraction 2alpha and preserve the remainder exactly.

E1.justification: v3 adds MS-COCO image captioning with InternVL2.5-8B, extending actual evaluation from text tasks to multimodal inputs. The original text benchmarks remain.

E2.justification: Table 6 adds ClusterGen to the LongBench-E comparison using Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. v2 does not evaluate this comparator; the original baseline comparisons are retained.

E3.justification: New evaluation designs include captioning at 1/4 and 1/16 retention with BLEU, METEOR, ROUGE-L, and CIDEr; LongBench tests at 0.8, 0.9, and 0.95 retention using partial compression; and QKV-norm aggregation across layers, heads, and prompt lengths. Previously reported protocols remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Section 4.5 and Appendix B.5 add analyses probing the bounded-norm assumption across sequence lengths and performance when most cache entries are retained. These substantially extend the questions examined beyond the retained layer, batch-size, and compression-rate ablations.

E5.justification: Table 3 introduces 95% confidence intervals for embedding-norm statistics. Existing ten-seed mean/standard-deviation reporting and ten-trial runtime reporting remain unchanged; no increase in their run counts is stated.

E6.justification: Tables 3–6 add four groups of results. Examples include captioning CIDEr of 1.221 versus uniform sampling's 1.207 at 1/16 retention, and LongBench-E averages of 46.77 for BalanceKV versus 46.62 for ClusterGen. Tables 1–2 and the existing figures retain their results.

T1.justification: Appendix A.1 substantially revises the main proof, adding discarded-value error analysis and explicit numerator/denominator error propagation, and changing epsilon rescaling from epsilon/3 to epsilon/4. Its bucket-cutoff analysis also changes, although Algorithm 1 retains the earlier cutoff. The theorem statements and lower-bound argument remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract and introduction retain the same claims about discrepancy-based streaming approximation, theoretical guarantees, lower bounds, and empirical effectiveness. The new conclusion summarizes these existing contributions.

C2.justification: v3 interprets approximately stable average QKV norms across sequence lengths as support for the bounded-norm assumptions. It also explains that shifting keys by their mean preserves attention. These interpretations are absent from v2.

D1.justification: Appendix B.5 newly discloses mean-centering keys before compression and explains partial-cache compression. Section 4.5 specifies an A100 with 80 GB VRAM for captioning. The centering disclosure does not establish that the existing implementation changed.

R1.justification: The same 85 referenced works and central research positioning are retained. ClusterGen cites the already referenced SubGen paper; citation renumbering does not add a new work.

P1.justification: v3 adds Additional Experiments subsections and a conclusion, expands the local exposition in Appendix A.1, reorders authors, and switches citation style. Most existing prose and the overall section sequence remain unchanged.

P2.justification: v3 adds Tables 3–6 and adjusts table styling, spacing, and placement of existing displays. The original plots, tree illustration, and heatmaps retain their content and designs; there is no broad visual redesign.

improvement.justification: Tables 3–6 broaden empirical support through multimodal testing, additional compression settings, and a direct ClusterGen comparison. Appendix A.1 makes previously omitted error reasoning explicit. These gains are limited by the proof's cutoff mismatch with Algorithm 1 and by norm averages that do not establish the required worst-case bounds.
